negative.sql:
SELECT pizzeria.name, COUNT(*) AS count_of_orders, AVG(menu.price) AS average_price, MAX(menu.price) AS max_price, MIN(menu.price) AS min_price
FROM person_order
JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id
JOIN pizzeria ON pizzeria.id = menu.pizzeria_id
GROUP BY pizzeria.name
ORDER BY pizzeria.name;

SELECT pizzeria.name, COUNT(*) AS count_of_orders, ROUND(AVG(menu.price), 1) AS average_price, MAX(menu.price) AS max_price, MIN(menu.price) AS min_price
FROM person_order
JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id
JOIN pizzeria ON pizzeria.id = menu.pizzeria_id
GROUP BY pizzeria.name
ORDER BY pizzeria.name;

negative.why: метрики по всему меню, а не по заказанным пиццам
negative.sql: SELECT pizzeria.name, COUNT(*) AS count_of_orders, ROUND(AVG(menu.price), 2) AS average_price, MAX(menu.price) AS max_price, MIN(menu.price) AS min_price FROM menu JOIN pizzeria ON pizzeria.id = menu.pizzeria_id GROUP BY pizzeria.name ORDER BY pizzeria.name;

SELECT pizzeria.name, COUNT(person_order.id) AS count_of_orders, ROUND(AVG(menu.price), 2) AS average_price, MAX(menu.price) AS max_price, MIN(menu.price) AS min_price FROM pizzeria LEFT JOIN menu ON menu.pizzeria_id = pizzeria.id LEFT JOIN person_order ON person_order.menu_id = menu.id GROUP BY pizzeria.name ORDER BY pizzeria.name;
